cleaning.title: Deck Cleaning with high-quality equipment
cleaning.desc: To prepare the floor for oiling we clean using  a unique soft brush Germany Engineered Terrassen-Blitz Sander. This powerful machine removes all previous coating,dirt,grey and moss without using water,hight pressure or chemicals.it removes most stubborn layers even in narrow edges and corners.Unlike conventional belt sanders with adrasive belts,there is no loss of the timber profile.Most importantly,the built-in vaccum cleaner sucks up dust, dirt and allergens so there is no health hazard.
